answer: On an attestation graph, assign trust by bounded-length random walks from verified seeds, normalizing transition probabilities by degree and capping each endpoint’s voting weight. If juniper, ledge, and lotus collude in a Sybil cluster, its sparse external cut has low conductance, so little walk mass enters per step. For fixed seed mass and walk horizon, the cut capacity therefore bounds the cluster’s credited voting weight, regardless of its raw node count.
